title: Go-Live Sentry Playbook & Metric Deconflict Log
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact operational playbook meant to act as the "go-live sentry" for medium-risk feature launches. Primary intent: avoid metric collisions and noisy alerts during the first 72 hours of ramp. Secondary intent: provide a deconflict log so metric owners can quickly reconcile overlapping signals and decide on an action (ignore/monitor/mitigate/roll back).

Scope and Audience:
- Scope: mid-tier launches that change inference routing, batching defaults, or rollout logic (hosted + dedicated). Not intended for infra-only platform upgrades — those have separate SRE runbooks.
- Audience: Product Ops (primary), SRE, Serving Runtime leads, growth experiments owner, and on-call escalation roster.

Quick TL;DR Run Sequence (for on-call/handoffs):
1) T-minus 2h: triage briefing (15m) — owners confirm measurement hooks + blackout windows.
2) T-minus 30m: health probes started on staging->prod smoke path.
3) T+0: soft traffic gate (10% user cohort) + enable sentry monitoring (this doc's watchlist).
4) First 2h: active monitoring cadence (5m checks), metric deconflict entries recorded.
5) T+2h to T+72h: graduated traffic + cadence relaxes to 30m checks unless anomalies persist.

Sentry Watchlist (primary signals and owners) — check every cycle:
- lat_95_inference_ms — owner: Serving Runtime (Liam Chen) — threshold: >900ms sustained 5m -> ACTION: throttle or revert routing.
- request_errors_5xx_rate (%) — owner: SRE (Devon O'Neal) — threshold: >1.5% over 10m -> ACTION: investigate model variant fallback.
- cost_per_1k_tokens_usd — owner: Product Finance (Sofia Rivera) — threshold: spike >40% from baseline 24h -> ACTION: pause noncritical batch jobs and inform PM.
- retention_model_quality_delta — owner: Applied ML (Priya Nambiar) — threshold: BLEU/embedding-sim drop >3% on golden prompts -> ACTION: rollback model version.
- routing_mismatch_rate — owner: Platform Eng — threshold: >0.7% -> ACTION: check canary policy rules.
- user-facing-fallback-rate — owner: Product ops — threshold: >0.2% -> ACTION: escalate to PM and communications.

Metric Deconflict Log (live entries - use this area to note overlapping alarms and reasoning):
- 2025-03-10 10:12 UTC | lat_95_inference_ms = 1,120ms; request_errors_5xx_rate = 0.6% | action: Observed spike attributed to warmup cold-start after rolling 20% of capacity to new runtime. Left cohort at 10%, enabled pre-warming script. Status: MONITOR. Owner note: INF-2381 linked.
- 2025-03-11 01:05 UTC | cost_per_1k_tokens_usd +25% | action: batch queue misrouted to dedicated test pool; fixed policy mapping in platform PR#1128. Status: RESOLVED.
- 2025-03-11 11:30 UTC | retention_model_quality_delta -3.7% on golden-20 set | action: temporarily pinned traffic to previous model variant; initiated quality postmortem. Status: ROLLBACK.

Preflight Checklist (T-minus items):
- [ ] Confirm telemetry hooks are live for every watchlist metric (tag: prodops/telemetry-check).
- [ ] Smoke test script passes full end-to-end user prompt path (owner: QA).
- [ ] Canary cohort selection validated (no overlapping cohorts with other launches).
- [ ] On-call roster confirmed for next 72h (names in Slack ping).
- [ ] Comms template ready for incident or rollback (customer-success + legal notified where required).
- [ ] Cost guardrails configured (automated throttle at X% budget burn).
- [ ] Log retention window extended + trace sampling increased for T+0..T+6h for deeper triage.

Immediate Play Actions (if threshold hit):
- Minor alert (single metric over threshold): increase check cadence, annotate deconflict log entry, ping owner in #prodops.
- Major alert (multiple signals or user-visible regressions): initiate troubleshooting pod -> hold traffic increase and consider immediate rollback.
- Latency-only spike with errors low: scale read path (autoscale), enable KV cache warmup, hold further rollout.
- Quality regressions: revert model variant, freeze feature flags, trigger eval-suite run against golden prompts.

Escalation Ladder (names / channels):
- Level 1: cohort owner + product-ops (slack:@product-ops-sentry) — 0-15 minutes
- Level 2: SRE lead (Devon O'Neal) + Serving Runtime lead (Liam Chen) — 15-45 minutes
- Level 3: VP Eng + Head of Product Ops + CS escalation — 45+ minutes or customer-impacting

Rollback & Safeguards (decision heuristics):
- Automatic throttle: if request_errors_5xx_rate > 3% for 5m OR lat_95_inference_ms > 2,000ms -> auto-throttle rule reduces new cohort allocation by 50%.
- Manual rollback: if model-quality delta > 3.5% on golden baseline OR user-facing-fallback-rate > 0.5% sustained 20m -> manual rollback recommended.
- Communications: CS to draft customer note within 30 minutes of rollback decision; legal to review if regulated data paths involved.

Simulations & Pre-schedule (recommended):
- 24h before: dry run with synthetic load at 0.5x expected peak; confirm metrics flow to dashboards.
- 2h before: tabletop with stakeholders (15m).
- Postmortem cadences: 48h interim note and 7-day deep postmortem.

Ownership table (compact):
- Product Ops: overall playbook owner, sentry coordinator (Aisha Patel)
- Serving Runtime: latency, cache, kernel fallback (Liam Chen)
- SRE: error rates, infra health, and automated throttles (Devon O'Neal)
- Applied ML: model quality signals, evals (Priya Nambiar)
- Finance: cost telemetry and alerts (Sofia Rivera)
- Customer Success: customer comms and impact assessment (Jared Kim)

Notes / Known Edge Cases:
- Overlapping canaries: when two experiments use the same cohort filters, metric collisions can create false positives. Always validate cohort exclusivity in the placement matrix.
- Synthetic traffic can mask cold-starts: schedule a warmup routine instead of relying solely on synthetic tests.
- Metrics spike correlation: prefer triage via traces first (request_id mapping) before toggling feature flags.

Post-launch Retro & Hand-off (template):
- Within 48h: publish a short Incident/Radar note into Confluence with: what changed, key metric deltas, deconflict log snapshot, timeline of actions, and next steps.
- 7 days: performance trend summary, cost delta, and recommended guardrail updates.

Quick commands & dashboards (ops cheat):
- Dashboards: PROD -> "Sentry / GoLive" (dash id: prodops-sentry-3)
- Logs: kinesis-prod -> filter: "feature_launch=<feature-name>"
- Traces: Jaeger -> tag: "launch-cohort"
- Rollback command (internal tool): /platform rollback --feature <id> --to <variant>

Appendix: sample deconflict entry format to paste into this doc:
TIMESTAMP | METRIC(S) | VALUE(S) | HYPOTHESIS | ACTION | STATUS | LINKED-ARTIFACTS
Example: 2025-03-11 11:30 UTC | retention_model_quality_delta | -3.7% | new tokenizer regress -> run eval | ROLLBACK | INF-2389 / PR#1132

Open questions to resolve pre-launch (owners):
- Does Finance want real-time cost alerts at 15m granularity for paid pilots? (owner: Sofia)
- Should we add a dedicated trace sample for each canary cohort? (owner: Liam)
- Do we need legal signoff for any model fallback that routes to external provider? (owner: Aisha -> Legal)

Last-minute reminders:
- Keep the deconflict log tidy — a single-line entry per observed anomaly is enough.
- When in doubt, reduce traffic and annotate. Conservative decisions win in first 72h.

Document history:
- 2025-02-10 created by Aisha Patel (initial template)
- 2025-03-12 updated to include automatic throttle heuristics and contact ladder

End of document.
